question: The Chera Panhara ritual is associated with:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rath Yatra in Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chera Panhara** is a ritual associated with the **Jagannath Temple in Puri, India.**
 
• It is a part of the annual **Rath Yatra festival.**
 
• **Rath Yatra involves** the ceremonial procession of the deities** Jagannath, Balabhadra, and Subhadra on chariots.**
 
• **Chera Panhara is a special ritual that takes place during the Rath Yatra procession.**
 
• The **Gajapati King of Puri sweeps the road with a golden broom before the chariots of the deities.**
 
• The **act symbolizes the humility of even the highest authority in front of the gods.**
 
• **It is also a symbolic gesture of the king's commitment to serving the gods and his people.**
